title: Six-Week Practicum
description: 6-week full-time placement designed for gaining practicum experience in aligning Indigenous pedagogical decisions with diverse contexts and learners.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of IED 361, ED-P 300A, ED-P 300B, ED-P 361.

items.text: Admission to BEd in Indigenous Language Revitalization or to the BEd post-degree professional program in Indigenous Education – Elementary
